plainTranslation: Their presence and the way they carry themselves work smoothly with your direction, ambitions, and public reputation.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
summaryShort: Their presence and the way they carry themselves work smoothly with your direction, ambitions, and public reputation.
summaryDeep: Their presence and the way they carry themselves work smoothly with your direction, ambitions, and public reputation. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
